display_long_description:
A watchful Overseer scans the mountain from the summit above. In High Ground, your objective is to reach the peak and disable it before sunrise. Travel across 5 worlds and 15 chapters that increasingly test your skills. Every movement drains energy, forcing you to carefully navigate the terrain and recharge at scattered platforms. Portal across chasms, evade enemies that drain your power, and reach the high ground before daylight exposes you. 

In multiplayer races, opponents climb beside you—use your EMP to disrupt enemies or blast rivals off the mountain on your way to the top.
 
# The Overseer is watching.
[media]

# Every move costs energy. Use it wisely.
[media]

# Portal your way to the summit.
[media]

# Everything wants you off the mountain.
[media]

# At the summit, disable the Overseer.
[media]
